u0: Initial active state: no successful box pickup has occurred yet, and the agent is not at the exit. The next objective is to find and pick up the box at least once, then head for the exit. Reaching the exit now would still terminate the episode, but it would miss the pickup-progress reward.
u1: Active post-pickup state: the agent has already picked up and carried the box at least once on a non-exit step, so the pickup milestone is complete. The remaining objective is to reach the exit. The box may still be in hand or may have fallen or been dropped; re-picking it is not required by this state, though carrying it is consistent with the task.
u2: Terminal success state: the agent has reached the exit and the episode is complete. No further objective remains; the final return includes the exit reward and any earlier box-pickup reward.
